entities.summary: Alin Mile Berescu is a Romanian chess grandmaster and FIDE trainer. He was the Vice-President of the Romanian Chess Federation. Berescu won the International Master title in 2001 and grandmaster title in 2007. He was the winner of the Romanian Chess Championship in 2004 and 2005.
